summary: Centralises TrailRenderer's scattered settings into a few fields, plus on/off control.
overview: Drop it on a thin child transform near the blade's edge, since a TrailRenderer draws from wherever ITS OWN transform has physically moved. The component gathers TrailRenderer's many scattered settings into a few clean fields with sensible defaults and adds explicit activation.
useCases: A sword or claw trail during a swing.
Turning a trail on only during active frames.

params.tuning: How long the trail persists. Long values on a fast swing leave a ribbon hanging in the air after the attack ends.
Usually off — a weapon trail that is always on removes the emphasis of the swing.

gotchas.title: It trails the transform it is ON
gotchas.body: Put it on a child at the blade's edge, not on the weapon root, or the trail comes from the hilt.

gotchas.title: Toggling off leaves the existing trail fading
gotchas.body: Clear it explicitly if a teleport should not drag a trail across the screen.
